entries.25a483ce76c800fa: As its management philosophy it sets out "Through free and vigorous, fair and disciplined corporate activities, create and develop food culture and realize customer satisfaction, shareholder returns, and social contribution," and its corporate message is "A Pinch of Happiness." Under the 6th Medium-Term Management Plan "Next Value up for 80," covering the period from the fiscal year ended March 2023 to the fiscal year ending March 2028, it aims for the 80th period vision of "a company that delivers snacks that are 'more' delicious, fun, and exciting," and is working on 3 priority strategies: expanding Natori fans by providing snacks with new fun, creating workplaces where all human resources can play an active role and find work rewarding, and initiatives for the SDGs and strengthening governance.
